notes.title: Update V1.2.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Get ready to rumble! Backyard Boxing V1.2.0 is here with a host of exciting new features, improvements, and fixes to enhance your boxing experience.

[b]New Features:[/b]

[b]Dynamic Camera System:[/b]  overhauled our camera system to provide a more immersive and dynamic viewing experience. The camera now smoothly tracks fighters, dynamically adjusting to their animations and the weight of punches for a more fluid and engaging fight.
[b]Intro Animations:[/b] Each round now kicks off with unique intro animations, adding a touch of flair and excitement to the beginning of every fight.
[b]Bare Knuckle Mode: [/b]Unleash your inner brawler! Players can now choose to fight without gloves in the new Bare Knuckle mode.
[b]Training Overhaul:[/b] Skill points have been removed. Now, train to improve your fighter's stats:
[b]Power: [/b]Increase your punching power by bench pressing.
[b]Speed:[/b] Enhance your striking speed by training with the punching bag.
[b]Health:[/b] Improve your overall health by sparring.
[b]Dynamic Drug Market: [/b]The drug market now features fluctuating prices. Prices change at the end of each fight and occasionally at random times, adding a layer of economic strategy to your fighter's development.
[b]New Random Events: [/b]Experience a variety of new random events in the menu, offering unexpected challenges and opportunities.
[b]Larger Crowds:[/b] Feel the roar of the crowd! We've added more spectators to amplify the excitement of each match.
[b]Gameplay Improvements:[/b]

[b]Enhanced Dodging:[/b] We've refined the dodging mechanics, making slipping punches more effective and rewarding skillful defensive play.
[b]Improved Sound Design:[/b] We've added more impactful sound effects for big blows, further immersing you in the action.
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

[b]Damage Balancing: [/b]Addressed and fixed a damage bug to ensure a more balanced and fair fighting experience.

notes.title: Backyard Boxing - Patch 1.1.6
notes.content:
[u][b]Title Screen HUD Overhaul[/b][/u]
The title screen has been redesigned to display key player stats, including money, fans, record, and schedule for a more immersive experience.

[u][b]Training Mode Improved & Updated[/b][/u]
Enhancements and new features added to the existing training mode.


[u][b]Dialogue System Temporarily Removed[/b][/u]
The previous dialogue system was causing aspect ratio issues on handheld devices.
It has been removed and is currently being redeveloped with full controller support and better compatibility in mind.
The system will return in a future update with improvements.

[u][b]Knockdown Mini-Game Update[/b][/u]
Introduced a spam key mechanic that increases in difficulty with each knockdown.

[u][b]Further Improved Gamepad Support[/b][/u]

Controller support has progressed, and some menu controls are now functional.
However, the game will still be labeled "No Controller Support" until full implementation is complete.

[u][b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b][/u]
Fixed aspect ratio issues for certain monitors to ensure proper scaling and UI alignment.

notes.title: Update V1.1.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Backyard Boxing V1.1.5 Patch Notes[/b]
[b]New Features & Improvements[/b]
[b]Damage State System:[/b] Fighters now visually show fight progression with:
Broken noses, bloody noses, black eyes, busted lips, cuts, sweat, & facial expression changes.
Currently, only Haezer's model is fully implemented with this system. Other fighters will receive updates in small patches over the next few days.
[b]Knockdown & Get Back Up System:[/b]
When knocked down, players must complete a minigame to get back up.
Lose the minigame or get knocked down 3 times, and you lose the fight.
[b]NPC AI Improvements:[/b]
[b]Better block-breaking mechanics: [/b]NPCs now attack blocks more effectively.
NPCs can now break the player’s block, increasing fight challenge and strategy.
[b]New Hit Reactions for NPCs: [/b]Improved realism in NPC reactions to punches.
[b]Camera Shake & Action Enhancements:[/b] Improved camera effects for better impact and immersion.
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Fixed a bug where players were incorrectly receiving rewards for Quick Fighting

notes.title: Update v.1.1.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Fatality Fix: [/b]Resolved an issue where the Fatality animation would get overridden by the push animation. Fatalities now properly execute without interruption.
[b]Fence Push Fix:[/b] NPCs can no longer push the player off the fences when their health is critical.
[b]Math Logic Fix: [/b]Adjusted game balance logic to improve distribution and overall gameplay fairness.
[b]Fight Timer Adjustments:[/b] Fights are now back to 60 seconds based on community feedback.
Enjoy the update and keep the feedback coming! 🔥👊

notes.title: Update v.1.1.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]V1.1.3 Patch Notes[/b]
[b]Round Timer Adjusted:[/b] Rounds are now set to 90 seconds.
[b]Player Health Recovery Improved:[/b] Players will now recover health more effectively.
[b]BUG FIX:[/b] Fixed an issue where cash balance could go negative.
[b]BUG FIX:[/b] Implemented a maximum money cap of $100 million to prevent bugs occurring at extreme amounts.
